                    ### Question
                    Which of the following correctly pairs a neurotransmitter with its location of synthesis?

                    ### Options
                    opa. Norepinephrine -- Caudate nucleus
opb. GABA -- Ventral tegmentum
opc. Dopamine -- Locus ceruleus
opd. Serotonin -- Raphe nucleus
ope. Acetylcholine -- Nucleus accumbens

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
Dopamine is synthesized in the substantia nigra, not the locus ceruleus. Serotonin is synthesized in the raphe nucleus, not the caudate nucleus. Acetylcholine is synthesized in the nucleus accumbens, as stated.
